newsitem.title: BELGIUM: INSIGHT - CHARTISTS MIXED ON BEL 20 INDEX.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - CHARTISTS MIXED ON BEL 20 INDEX.

text.p: Belgian analysts have mixed views on the trend of the Bel-20 share index. Trading tools give a cautious indication of a possible reversal but confirmation will be needed, possibly through a close above 1800.
The indecision of the market also shows in candlestick charts.
Strong support at 1780-1790 is still seen intact.

Last week the Bel-20 closed at 1,795.03, down from 1,810.07
on October 25.
Contributors' own analysis (alphabetical order).
CERA BANK - The Bel-20 will be driven by earnings, Wall Street and a stronger dollar and less by interest rates.
Although the focus in the coming days will be on the U.S.

elections. We expect earnings of Belgian companies will be up 12 percent. In our opinion the dollar will trade at 1.56 marks in 3 months and 1.57 marks in one year. The Dow should trade at the same levels in 12 months. We believe Belgian business confidence will rise further confirming signs of recovery that began at the start of the year. As a result we expect the economy will continue to grow without fuelling inflation and we prefere cyclical stocks above interest-sensitive stocks (Guy Sips).

ECOFIS - The three last weeks in the weekly candlesticks formed a weak doji evening star, potentially a pause-to-reversal configuration. Between last Monday and Tuesday a bearish window was formed. Last Wednesday support at 1800 was breached, but very undecisively. Thursday's candle is a doji star, confirming the indecision of the market. The first two days of this week are likely to be important, either for seeing a move back to above 1800, or for confirmation of the decline seen over the last eight working days. But the uptrend remains intact until support at 1759 and 1750 are breached (Frank Boll) GENERALE BANK - Market orientation remained negatively biased, but the important 1780 support level was not tested.
Instead a small intermediate support appeared just above 1790.

The trend remains neutral but today's pick up means some positive signs reappear. Trading tools give an early indication of a possible reversal while confirmation is needed. A close above 1800 will confirm this pattern. As long as the important support level at 1780 stays into place, the potential for further gains remains unharmed (Geert Vanderbeke) PARIBAS - Last week, the Bel-20 showed a correction towards the 1790 level, which is a 50 percent retracement on the upward move from the 1760 low (Oct 10) towards 1825 high (Oct 22).

Although the short-term picture is in negative territory, the longer-term picture remains positive as long as this 1790 strong support level holds, with 1850 as target, A break on the downside however, could extend the correction further towards the 1760 level (Philip Tortelboom)
